title: Spreedly reduces enterprise sales cycles by 47 days
summary: Tyler Hodgins, Senior Director of Customer Success, is responsible for ensuring that Spreedly’s solutions not only meet the needs of customers but also accelerate adoption and drive measurable business outcomes.
body_markdown:
[Spreedly](https://www.spreedly.com/) , leading open payments platform, empowers merchants through an open, secure and inclusive payment ecosystem, unlocking choice among PSPs, fraud tools and other innovative payment services.


Tyler Hodgins, Senior Director of Customer Success, is responsible for ensuring that Spreedly’s solutions not only meet the needs of customers but also accelerate adoption and drive measurable business outcomes.
